product_metadata.title: Norpro Stainless Steel Seafood Forks 6.75" | 4-Count per Pack | 1-Pack
features: The ultimate tool to prepare and eat shellfish with ease! Great for crab, lobster, oysters and more!

Each double-ended pick has a scoop on one end and fork on the other end. With a forked end to pierce and a spoon end to scoop, these picks efficiently remove every morsel of meat from a variety of shellfish.
Use the fork end to dip seafood into butter and sauces!
Also great for spearing olives and cherries in a jar! Made of heavy-duty stainless steel for stability and strength.
description: Set of 4 stainless steel seafood forks easily remove meat from shellfish. Spoon shaped end for scooping and tined end for picking. You'll find lots of uses for these slender seafood forks from Norpro. Not only are they terrific for retrieving lobster and crabmeat from the shell, they're also great for spearing olives and cherries in a jar. The picks are made from durable stainless steel and each pick measures 7 Inch long.
